name: Project Kickoff
description: Produces a complete project kickoff document with scope statement, success criteria, milestone list with dates, stakeholder map, risk list, and communication plan. Built from the user's project description for personal or small-team projects. Use when the user asks about starting a new project, creating a project plan, writing a project charter, or setting up a project for success. Do NOT use for enterprise project management with multiple teams (use business project-management skills), product roadmap creation (use business strategy skills), or ongoing project status tracking (use project-status-report).
